violations.description: Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. - Found wet cloth in hand wash sink.

Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. - Items with no dates found in prep cooler.
Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not kept clean or maintained. - Wet cloth found in sink at time of inspection.
Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. - Behind hand soap needs cleaned.
